title: OPM finalizes ‘Nixonian’ rule centralizing and enabling some federal firings
summary: Under final regulations published this week, the federal government’s dedicated HR agency can remove federal employees from across government over suitability and conduct issues—blocking most avenues for appeal.

title: Union accuses Treasury and HHS of neglecting telework requests from employees with disabilities
summary: The lawsuit highlights federal employees who have been waiting for more than a year to hear back about their reasonable accommodation requests as well as individuals whose need to telework ended before the agency responded.

title: Some TSP funds faltered in June
summary: Following two straight months of gains, the federal government’s 401(k)-style retirement savings program posted a more muted performance last month.

title: Inside the competing federal efforts behind America’s 250th anniversary plans
summary: Federal and White House-led initiatives are rolling out overlapping programming for the semiquincentennial, including National Mall events, court open houses and nationwide commissions that will shape how the 250th anniversary is marked.

title: Slaughter and the expansion of presidential power
summary: COMMENTARY | The Supreme Court’s latest ruling has dismantled a century of independence for federal regulators, and the ripples of this decision may just be the start of a much broader reshaping of the executive branch.

title: America at 250: What the Census reveals about our journey
summary: COMMENTARY | As the United States approaches its 250th birthday, the Census Bureau offers a vivid way to trace the country’s growth, movement and change from the earliest days of the republic.

title: IRS agrees to stop stealing workers’ pro-union decorations
summary: The National Treasury Employees Union sued the agency earlier this month after multiple instances in which management confiscated and disposed of flyers and other decorations from employees’ workstations and communal bulletin boards.

title: Judge halts Trump administration effort to exert political control over union elections
summary: U.S. District Judge Denise Caspar said the Federal Labor Relations Authority’s move earlier this year to usurp jurisdiction over some cases from career employees was arbitrary and capricious under the Administrative Procedure Act.

title: Despite criticism of Trump’s SES reforms, senior executives group backs recent updates to training program
summary: Officials from the Office of Personnel Management said that the changes to the training and development program are necessary to promote standardization across agencies.

title: Pentagon launches ‘War Force’ initiative to onboard tech talent
summary: The new recruitment effort was started in partnership with the Office of Personnel Management and operates under that agency’s larger Tech Force program.

title: Lawmaker warns of administration’s ‘fetishization’ of Silicon Valley startups
summary: Rep. James Walkinshaw, D-Va., discussed his plans to scrutinize Trump-era contracting practices, revive federal IT oversight and push for AI policy.

title: OPM’s new suitability authority blurs the line between hiring vetting and employee discipline
summary: COMMENTARY | A change allowing suitability actions for post-appointment misconduct could reshape how agencies respond to issues uncovered through continuous vetting, but the Office of Personnel Management’s willingness to use it will determine whether it becomes a routine tool or a rarely used exception.

title: Lawmakers, unions and civil society groups urge withdrawal of governmentwide NDA plan
summary: The Office of Personnel Management received more than 30,000 comments on its plan to require federal workers sign nondisclosure agreements, which critics said would violate the First Amendment and chill whistleblowers.

title: What an ICE leadership pick signals about the next phase of immigration enforcement
summary: The nominee would take charge of an agency with billions in new resources and an expanding role in carrying out the administration's deportation agenda.

title: One federal research network got a reprieve. Others may not
summary: Congress rescued a federally funded ocean research initiative, highlighting broader questions about which government programs will be spared from the administration's push to shrink federal research.

title: President can fire independent agency heads without cause, Supreme Court rules
summary: Justice Sonia Sotomayor wrote in a dissent that the decision “reshapes our government.”

title: GSA’s centralization push is a return to its roots, not just a Trump priority
summary: The General Services Administration's acting acquisition chief says the consolidation drive mirrors the founding mission laid out by the Hoover Commission 77 years ago.

title: Despite taxing year, IRS watchdog reports mostly smooth filing season
summary: The Taxpayer Advocate Service did, however, find that staff cuts made it more difficult for taxpayers who needed assistance to access it.

title: Secret Service phone security lapses put US officials at risk, watchdog says
summary: The DHS inspector general found that agents routinely used personal phones for official work, including during protective operations, because government-issued devices lacked key capabilities.

title: Artificial intelligence is cutting months off nuclear licensing review times, official says
summary: Basia Sall, chief data officer and deputy chief AI officer at the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, said on Thursday that the technology is shortening review timelines while testing how far automated tools can improve regulatory work.

title: Oregon lawsuit could upend federal management of public lands
summary: Federal plans for millions of acres of land could be invalid under a new interpretation of a 1996 law.

title: As opposition mounts, House cancels vote on VA overhaul bill
summary: House Democrats and veterans service organizations warned that a bill Republicans claim will increase benefits "robs Peter to pay Paul" and hastens efforts to privatize veteran health care.
